prompt.project_info: Hyper-realistic ultra-detailed close-up wide-angle selfie of an original adult woman sunbathing on a luxury yacht in bright open-water sunlight, with polished high-fashion summer lifestyle treatment.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with jet-black hair and neon-green roots, wet hair clinging naturally to the shoulders, fair skin with cool undertones and subtle sun-kissed warmth, realistic wet-skin sheen, strong original facial structure, full lips, expressive light-colored eyes, dramatic dark eye makeup, long lashes and bold classic red lipstick. She wears a red glossy one-piece swimsuit with side cutouts and reflective synthetic fabric, a gold reflective visor with no logo, and large silver hoop earrings. Do not reproduce Billie Eilish or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Use a handheld eye-level close-up selfie with the adult woman's face and upper body in sharp foreground focus as she holds the camera while sunbathing. Include a polished metal yacht ladder, sparkling blue open water, blurred luxury yacht details and a distant shoreline or marina. Keep the background softly blurred and the subject's face and wet hair clear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural sunlight with high contrast creates strong water highlights and reflections on polished metal, visor, earrings and wet fabric. Use vivid saturated summer reds and blues with realistic water sparkle, luxurious confident atmosphere and natural skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic wide-angle smartphone selfie, close-up upper-body framing, shallow depth of field, sharp subject and softly blurred background, realistic synthetic fabric, metal, visor, water and wet hair texture, no text, logo or watermark.
